entries.what: A guard that refused the exposure while still copying to the person it was protecting
entries.detail: A specification that failed closed on disclosure and open on consent. As first specified, a published plain file carrying an address was refused, and the page fell through to this computer’s copy; where that copy lacked the address, Copy rich copied to the person who had opted out — measured on 81 of 81 pages. Ruled: a refused published file holds every page, local copy or not, until the hashed route ships. Re-proved on the trigger case on 81 of 81.
